candidate.title: UK Biobank: An Open Access Resource for Identifying the Causes of a Wide Range of Complex Diseases of Middle and Old Age
candidate.abstract: Cathie Sudlow and colleagues describe the UK Biobank, a large population-based prospective study, established to allow investigation of the genetic and non-genetic determinants of the diseases of middle and old age.
candidate.authors: C. Sudlow, J. Gallacher, N. Allen, V. Beral, Paul R. Burton, J. Danesh, P. Downey, P. Elliott

panel.reason: UK Biobank核心资源描述，属公开大规模队列数据资源。
UKB核心资源奠基文献，该方向必读

extraction.method: UK Biobank大型前瞻队列资源建设
extraction.data: >50万40-69岁参与者，问卷、样本、影像、基因
extraction.scenario: 复杂疾病病因与风险研究
extraction.benchmark: 既往病例对照及小型前瞻研究
extraction.results: 预计20年随访积累糖尿病68,000、冠心病47,000、阿尔茨海默30,000等病例
extraction.availability: 开放申请，需bona fide研究者
extraction.limitations: 健康志愿者偏倚、年龄范围有限、随访期内病例累积需时间
extraction.summary: 介绍UK Biobank作为50万人前瞻队列，2006-2010招募并持续采集表型、样本、影像、基因和健康结局。设计基于统计功效，支持多种中老年复杂疾病的前瞻研究。资源开放给合格研究者，预计20年随访可积累大量常见病病例。
